answer: Admission runs through a single jetty: a narrow, rate-limited channel where each new identity must present a ferrous bond, an iron stake salted to its own address so one deposit cannot back two faces. Bonds are recorded in a jade ledger, an attestation graph in which every endorsement is a signed edge. Influence is bounded by the min-cut between a cluster and the honest core, so N clones chained through one thin cut share one cut's capacity while paying N full bonds: cost per unit of power grows with N. A random canary audit re-checks sampled bonds each epoch and slashes bought edges.
